company.name: Kaykroo
company.shortDescription: Kaykroo is a food-tech business that provides a virtual restaurant cloud kitchen platform.
company.description:
kaykroo is a UAE-based foodtech company redefining the future of food delivery through a scalable cloud kitchen ecosystem. Founded by hospitality professionals with more than a decade of experience in the F&B industry, the company combines culinary innovation, operational efficiency, and technology to build and operate a portfolio of homegrown food brands across the Middle East.

Built on a data-driven “brick & click” model, kaykroo integrates physical kitchen infrastructure with digital-first operations, enabling rapid brand development, optimized delivery performance, and scalable market expansion. The platform blends modern technology with regional culinary preferences to create diverse dining experiences tailored to evolving consumer demand.

Since launching in September 2020, kaykroo has expanded rapidly across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, operating more than 30 cloud kitchens and brand residences supported by a workforce of over 700 employees. The company currently manages a portfolio of 40+ distinct food brands and experiences, with ongoing investment in new concepts developed by its in-house culinary and innovation teams.

By leveraging centralized operations, customer insights, and multi-brand kitchen models, kaykroo aims to become the leading cloud kitchen network in the region while driving profitability, scalability, and convenience in the digital food delivery sector.
